sections.name: ContactLink
sections.title: Contact link helper
sections.what: Makes a clickable contact link that opens in a new tab, and adds https to any address that does not start with http.
sections.why: Lets the user type a short address such as a LinkedIn path without the full web prefix.
sections.watch_out: Email addresses and phone numbers would become broken web links because https is added to them.

inputs: The saved profile from storage or the seed profile. The packet did not show user input on this page.
